If you have new Ryzen chips do not enable PBO, or auto OC without adjusting voltage. The stock settings heavily overvolt the CPU, as high as 1.5 on a 3900x. This is far too high and will degrade the CPU. Please for the love of god make sure your CPU is not overvolting. 1.35v should be the max safe voltage. Ideally you want to shoot for stable performance at 1.30v if you plan on running 24/7.
